jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET/Python)
jobs.location: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you a wizard with C#/.NET and Python?

Then we're looking for YOU!

The Play Software department at the LEGO Group focuses on enabling engaging and seamless digital experiences by developing innovative software tools and platforms. The Senior Software Engineer role supports this by delivering high-quality software solutions that empower developers to build interactive LEGO experiences efficiently.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain modular, testable, deployable, and easy-to-maintain software solutions for interactive LEGO products using a mix of C# .NET, AvaloniaUI, and Python to name a few.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create tools that support developers in creating tech-enabled LEGO experiences, considering developer experience.
Ensure high software quality through code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration, with a strong emphasis on unit testing, while being comfortable with context switching between projects.
Support the automation of pipelines and toolchain development to improve developer efficiency and quality of life, balancing between perfecting software and making rapid delivery.
Engage in architectural discussions to drive innovation and technical excellence, making loosely coupled IT solutions.
Mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance and best practices, and fostering an environment eager to teach, learn, and experiment with an agile mindset.
Embrace the "You build it, you run it, you own it" philosophy, ensuring ownership and accountability for the software developed.

Requirements

Comfortable with C and C++ to a level that they can navigate codebases in these languages.
Experience in software development with C# .NET, with a proven ability to optimize software for performance and scalability.
Ability to engage in architectural discussions to drive innovation and technical excellence, seeing the red line across a tool portfolio and putting it into a system.
Experience with Git and Git actions, and a strong understanding of security and data privacy.
Demonstrated experience in automating development pipelines and improving developer toolchains, with knowledge of Docker.
Comfortable working with cloud endpoints and backend integration.

Nice to have

Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
Proficiency in scripting languages like Python for automation tasks.
Familiarity with cloud services and backend integration.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave
- We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances
– All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing
- We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount
– We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus
- We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace
- When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

jobs.description:
P-1451

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will join a team of engineers to build features that contribute directly to the Databricks platform. We're hiring across all of our teams, including full stack, backend, infrastructure, systems, tools, cloud, databases, and customer-facing products. You will have a dedicated mentor and will join our 2027 intern cohort where you'll connect with engineers, other interns, and leaders from across the company.

We are hiring Software Engineering Interns across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days.

The Impact You Will Have

Work with a team to build features for the Databricks platform
Manage your project end-to-end, including design, code, and feedback
Learn about building a platform that scales quickly while maintaining quality and security

What We Look For

You will graduate between fall 2027 and summer 2028 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject
You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Python, Java, or C++
You have good knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles
You are excited to solve ambiguous problems with a collaborative team

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior FullStack Engineer (Python+.Net)
jobs.description:
About The Role

In this role, you'll build the backend services that keep critical infrastructure data moving accurately and reliably. Working across Python and .NET, you'll design and deliver data processing systems for energy sector clients, partnering closely with architects and engineers to turn complex requirements into dependable, production-ready solutions.

Responsibilities

Design and develop backend applications using Python (FastAPI) and .NET (ASP.NET Core) that power data processing pipelines for energy infrastructure clients
Improve system performance and reliability by optimizing event-driven architectures built on Kafka and containerized deployments managed with Helm Charts
Collaborate closely with architects, QA engineers, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, production-ready solutions
Build and maintain .NET services using EF Core, async programming, and REST APIs, ensuring code quality, maintainability, and adherence to client IT standards
Apply test-driven development practices to deliver reliable, well-tested code across both Python and .NET codebases
Take part in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, to plan and deliver work iteratively
Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices to maintain high delivery quality
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across distributed systems, minimizing disruption to services that handle critical data

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of experience delivering IT solutions aligned with client IT strategy and standards
Hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, Kafka, and Helm Charts
Practical experience with .NET 8+, EF Core, TDD, async programming, REST APIs, and authentication/authorization
Working knowledge of Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in distributed, data-intensive systems
Clear communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional and client teams
Experience with Kubernetes, Argo CD, Protobuf, Pydantic, or Grafana
Background in electrical engineering, or experience with transmission system operators or comparable energy infrastructure companies
Familiarity with SCADA, PMU, PQ, protection, or fault record data
Experience working in critical infrastructure environments
Strong communication skills

Qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship, disability, health condition, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Full Stack Softwareontwikkelaar .NET/Azure (Freelance kan)
jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als full stack softwareontwikkelaar werk je mee aan digitale toepassingen met een zichtbare impact op stedelijke dienstverlening en interne processen in Antwerpen. Je realiseert end-to-end oplossingen, van backend-services en API's tot performante en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces, binnen een moderne cloudomgeving op Microsoft Azure.

In samenwerking met architecten, analisten en andere ontwikkelaars bouw je aan onderhoudbare, veilige en schaalbare applicaties. Je neemt ownership over features van analyse tot oplevering en productie, en draagt actief bij aan een cultuur van continue verbetering, kennisdeling en technische kwaliteit.

Je ontwikkelt moderne webapplicaties met .NET (C#), ASP.NET en Angular.
Je ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt REST API's en backend-services.
Je implementeert performante frontends en werkt waar relevant ook met React of andere moderne JavaScript-frameworks.
Je werkt met relationele databanken en SQL.
Je gebruikt Microsoft Azure voor hosting, storage, RBAC, App Services, Virtual Machines, security en deployment.
Je zet CI/CD-processen op en onderhoudt ze binnen Azure DevOps, met aandacht voor Git en degelijk versiebeheer.
Je past security-by-design en DevSecOps-principes toe in de softwareontwikkeling.
Je werkt in een Agile/Scrum-context en draagt bij aan code reviews, testing, codekwaliteit en een doordachte softwarearchitectuur.
Je denkt technisch en functioneel mee met business stakeholders en ondersteunt technische analyse en UML-modellering.
Je werkt mee aan innovatie-initiatieven rond AI, machine learning, data-analyse en computer vision.
Afhankelijk van de noden van het project zet je bijkomende tools en technologieën in, zoals Docker, Figma, Java Spring Boot, UX/UI-design of cloudplatformen zoals AWS.

Jouw profiel

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met de ontwikkeling van .NET-gebaseerde toepassingen.
Je hebt een aantoonbare opleiding in programmeertalen en omgevingen zoals .NET (C#) en ASP.NET.
Je voert programmeeropdrachten vlot uit: coderen, testen en debuggen, eventueel met enige coaching of begeleiding.
Je hebt ervaring met Angular, REST API's, Git, relationele databanken en SQL.
Je bent vertrouwd met Azure DevOps en CI/CD-processen.
Je hebt basiskennis van Agile ontwikkelingsmethodiek en werkt graag binnen Scrum-teams.
Je hebt aandacht voor softwarearchitectuur, codekwaliteit, testing en informatieveiligheid, bijvoorbeeld binnen ISO 27001-kaders.
Je behaalde een bachelor Toegepaste Informatica of beschikt over gelijkwaardige ervaring.
Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands; een Nederlandstalig niveau C2 volgens het Europees CEFR-kader is vereist.
Je bent resultaatgericht, pragmatisch, analytisch en leergierig.
Je werkt graag samen, deelt vlot kennis en neemt verantwoordelijkheid op van analyse tot oplevering.
Ervaring met AI-, machine learning- of computer vision-projecten is een meerwaarde.

Waarom deze rol?

In deze functie bouw je mee aan digitale oplossingen die dagelijks door veel gebruikers worden ingezet. Je krijgt de kans om met moderne technologieën te werken, je verder te ontwikkelen binnen een multidisciplinair team en bij te dragen aan toepassingen met maatschappelijke relevantie.

Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer .NET
jobs.description:
About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain complex software components that align with business and technical requirements. You will take ownership of feature implementation, troubleshoot technical challenges, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. Your role will involve contributing to technical discussions, refining best practices, and supporting junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing. Your expertise in programming and software engineering will be essential for achieving project goals and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products.

This role is based in Madrid.

What will you be doing?

Contribute to system architecture discussions and develop software components aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.
Creating high-quality, maintainable code in accordance with company best practices and standards.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and optimization to ensure performance, scalability, and reliability.
Develop and maintain cloud-based APIs, microservices, and integrations as part of a collaborative engineering team.
Support junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and sharing technical insights.
Collaborate with the team to refine task prioritization and align work with project goals.
Tackling complex problems requiring deep analysis and evaluation of diverse factors.
Collaborating closely with other teams and departments, such as product teams to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements.
Communicate effectively with team members and external stakeholders to clarify requirements and share progress updates.
Participate in technical discussions, advocate for improvements, and help resolve disagreements constructively.
Providing timely, concise, and actionable feedback to team colleagues.
Share knowledge through documentation, workshops, or informal team sessions.
Assist in technical interviews to evaluate candidates for your team.
Maintaining openness to communication with both local and external partners.
Proactively learn new tools and practices (e.g., DevOps, cloud services) to expand technical expertise.

What are we looking for?

Experience in designing and developing advanced software systems.
Proficiency in object-oriented programming concepts, algorithms, and data structures.
Continuous focus on enhancing skills in software architecture design, and product development.
Strong orientation toward task automation to save time and effort.
Implementation of improvements and optimizations in daily operations.
Planning and managing complex multi-system deployments without impacting client operations.
Ability to balance the demands of delivering high-quality software within tight deadlines.
Programming across multiple languages (C#, JavaScript, Java in plus).
Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Expertise in cloud infrastructure automation.
Knowledge and experience in use of design patterns
Fluency in English is required for this role.

The tech stack

C# .NET - Required
RDBMS / SQL - Required
TypeScript - Preferred
Javascript - Preferred
Amazon Web Services - Required

What do we offer?

💸 Clear and transparent compensation plan.
The salary range goes from 47,000 € to 68,000 €
. We will discuss the indicated range with you in the first recruiting call to ensure that we are on the same page.

💰 Flexible salary benefits

Save on personal income tax with Cobee for expenses like transport, restaurants, and kindergarten.

🩺 Private health insurance

Free for all employees via Cigna
, plus we cover 50% for your family members
.

🌅 Generous time off

Enjoy 26 days of holiday per year
(23 base days + your 🎂 birthday off
, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve).

💻 Your gear, your choice

Whether you prefer Mac or Windows
, or need an extra screen, we’ll make sure you’re set up for success from day one.

🗓️ Annual Salary Review

We’re committed to recognizing your professional growth. Every year, we review salaries to reflect your individual development, achievements, and impact on our business success.

📙 Grow your skills

We offer up to €2000/year
in training (certifications, conferences, workshops) to boost your growth—both technical and personal.

📺 Learning resources

Access internal and external training
, including platforms like LinkedIn Learning
, completely free.

🧘‍♂️ Holistic wellness program

Includes access to Wellhub, Curalinc (psychological support), Rocketlawyer (legal advice), and regular health webinars & challenges.

😊 Volunteer day

Take one day off a year
to volunteer and give back. Bonus points for sharing pics on Slack!

👩‍⚕️ Free therapy vouchers

Because your mental health matters.

🏐 Health & wellness support

Get up to €55/month
to cover your gym or fitness classes (yoga, boxing, pilates, etc.).

🗺️ Weekly language classes

Improve or learn a new language (English, Spanish, French, Italian, or German) in small groups with expert instructors—on us!

🏥 Time for health

Get 8 hours per year
for personal medical appointments and 10 hours per year
to support your family’s medical needs.

⚖️ Work-life balance

We’re flexible and people-first. We know life happens, and we aim to make work work for you.

💜 Inclusive, upbeat culture

No suits here—just a welcoming, casual, and respectful space where diversity is celebrated
, and you can be your full self.

🌍 A global, multicultural team

We’re made up of 20+ nationalities
, speaking 10+ languages
. All communication is in English, so everyone’s included.

📦 Packlink Pro discount

Enjoy 99% off
your personal shipments using our platform.

🔗 Referral bonuses

Know someone amazing? Earn €1K–€3K
when you refer candidates we hire—depending on the role.

🏢 Central Madrid office

When you want a change of scenery, drop by our office in the heart of Madrid— free snacks and drinks included
!

🏟️ Team events

We work hard and play hard with regular team-building activities and meetups.
